scope: Regression verification for strict flower temporal repair, packed-track slicing, and full-window stitching
summary: The invalid monotonic-fade test fixture was corrected to satisfy window coverage first; all 21 targeted CPU tests then passed on the remote execution copy.
evidence: The first remote run produced 20 passes and one failure because the increasing-weight fixture also violated left/right frame coverage and therefore correctly raised the earlier coverage error.
After changing the fixture cut/right starts to a valid global mapping, the same six test files completed with 21 passed in 0.24 seconds.

The tested paths include fail-closed motion recovery, repair policy routing, immutable packed-track slicing, stitch mapping/weight validation, real instance prompt validation, and packed-track merging.
lessons: A validation-order test must satisfy all earlier preconditions before asserting a later error contract.
limitations: These are CPU unit tests; GPU SAM2 acceptance is documented separately by real-input gate reports.
next_actions: Keep the stitch preview PARTIAL until its post-stitch hand and aligned gates pass.
